topography.project_purpose: Options. Structurally: 29 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens, 7 ERC721 NFTs, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (hegicoptions, pricecalculator, whassetv2). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
